method:
Hand review of ops/data/glp1-face/ctgov-raw.json (from glp1_face_ctgov.py), 2026-10-23 ET, plus number checks
against saved source text in ops/data/glp1-face/ (PubMed abstracts, PMC full text, FDA labels).
Kept: studies on ClinicalTrials.gov that enroll people taking a GLP-1 drug and measure the face or skin.
Excluded: the other records, which matched only on words such as "filler" (cod fillet), "face-to-face", or facial
flushing/headache, and are not about appearance.
ctgov_query: (semaglutide OR tirzepatide OR "GLP-1" OR GLP1 OR Ozempic OR Wegovy OR Mounjaro OR Zepbound) AND (face OR facial OR cheek OR midface OR "Ozempic face" OR filler OR "skin laxity" OR "skin quality")
